title: 5 Attars Every Indian Groom Should Own
excerpt: From nikah morning to sangeet night — five attars that complete a groom's wardrobe.
content:
A wedding is a week of moments, and each deserves its own scent. Here are the five attars we recommend to grooms — and the people who shop for them.

## 1. Royal Oud Al Malaki for the ceremony
Deep and regal, it photographs well and lasts through long rituals. Apply a small dab behind the ears and on the wrists.

## 2. Musk Al Haram for the nikah morning
Soft and clean. Musk is traditionally worn for prayer, and it stays gentle in close company.

## 3. Sandal Safeed for the mehendi
Cooling and calm, perfect for a hot, crowded afternoon.

## 4. Amber Al Qadeem for the reception
Warm and inviting for the evening, especially in winter weddings.

## 5. Khus for the day after
The cooling scent of khus is a gift after days of celebration.

Still choosing? Message us on WhatsApp and we will build a wedding set for you.

title: Oud 101: Understanding Agarwood
excerpt: What makes oud so precious, and how to choose one you'll love.
content:
Oud is the resin-rich heartwood of the agarwood tree, formed when the tree responds to a fungal infection. It takes decades — which is why real oud is expensive.

## Assam vs Cambodian oud
Assam oud is animalic, earthy and deep. Cambodian oud is sweeter, with fruity and leathery notes.

## Oud vs musk
Oud is bold and woody; musk is soft and skin-like. Many people wear musk daily and save oud for occasions.

## How to wear oud
Start with one dab. A little goes a long way — oud blooms on skin over an hour.

title: How to Layer Attar Like a Pro
excerpt: Simple pairings that make your attar last longer and smell uniquely yours.
content:
Layering is an old tradition: a light musk base, a floral heart and a dab of oud on top.

## Start with a base
Apply unscented oil or a light musk to pulse points after a shower.

## Add your heart
Rose or amber over musk gives sweetness and depth.

## Finish with oud
A very small dab of oud on the wrists or on your clothes' inner fold makes it last for days.

## Where to apply
Wrists, behind the ears, base of the throat. Do not rub — let the oils settle.

## How to store
Keep bottles tightly closed, away from sunlight and heat.
